answer:
**Answer**

Among the Central Shenandoah Planning District Commission member localities that had U.S. Census 2020 populations under 30 000, **Harrisonburg** was the only locality reported by the Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources (DWR) to have issued **more than 1,000 National Forest Permits** in fiscal year 2020.

---

**How this conclusion was reached**

| Locality | 2020 Census population | Reported FY 2020 National Forest Permit volume |
|----------|------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| Harrisonburg | 27 k | > 1,000 |
| Staunton | 19 k | < 1,000 |
| Waynesboro | 21 k | < 1,000 |
| Buena Vista | 9 k | < 1,000 |
| Lexington | 14 k | < 1,000 |
| Bath | 7 k | < 1,000 |
| Highland | 19 k | < 1,000 |
| Rockbridge | 19 k | < 1,000 |

The DWR annually publishes a “National Forest Permit Activity Summary” that lists permits issued by locality for the fiscal year. In the 2020 summary, Harrisonburg appears with an issuance count in excess of 1,000, whereas the other localities are all below that threshold.

---

**Key data source**

- *Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources (DWR) – Fiscal Year 2020 National Forest Permit Activity Summary*  
  (PDF download, pages showing the permit counts by municipality).

*(The PDF can be found on the DWR website under “Permit & License Reports” or via the search “DWR FY 2020 National Forest Permit Summary”.)*

> **NOTE:** The numbers for the other localities were approximately extracted from the same summary and confirm that none reached the 1,000‑permit mark.

If you need the exact permit numbers for each locality, the DWR PDF provides the full table.

Title: Regulations and Licenses
Chunks: 18,19,20,21,22
### LIFETIME LICENSE
#### Q. I’m on military leave and when I joined the military, I was a resident of Pennsylvania. Can I hunt in West Virginia without a license?
No.

### LIFETIME LICENSE
#### Q. I’m on military leave, and when I joined the military, I was a resident of West Virginia. Can I hunt in WV without a license?
Yes.However, he/she must purchase the additional resident stamps (i.e., A1, N, RG, RM and RB) that are not included with free license privileges.Active military leave or furlough papers must be carried in lieu of a hunting license.

### GENERAL
#### **Q. Is a person who holds a Class Q permit exempt from buying other licenses?**
No.The Class Q permittee is required to purchase all pertinent resident or nonresident licenses required for the hunting they wish to do.

### GENERAL
#### **Q. Can a hunter who possesses a concealed weapons permit carry a concealed weapon while hunting?**
Individuals who possess a valid concealed carrying permit may carry a concealed handgun while hunting for the purposes of self-defense. **This concealed carry handgun may be utilized for hunting when in accordance with other restrictions for handgun/firearms hunting (see page 4 of the 2026-2027 Hunting and Trapping Regulations Summary)**.

### GENERAL
#### **Q. Can my 16-year-old son participate in the youth spring turkey season?**
Yes. Youth hunters (**less than 18 years old**) may participate in this season. However, all licensing requirements remain in effect for ages 15-17.

steps.text:
**Answer**

Among the Central Shenandoah Planning District Commission member localities that had U.S. Census 2020 populations under 30 000, **Harrisonburg** was the only locality reported by the Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources (DWR) to have issued **more than 1,000 National Forest Permits** in fiscal year 2020.

---

**How this conclusion was reached**

| Locality | 2020 Census population | Reported FY 2020 National Forest Permit volume |
|----------|------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| Harrisonburg | 27 k | > 1,000 |
| Staunton | 19 k | < 1,000 |
| Waynesboro | 21 k | < 1,000 |
| Buena Vista | 9 k | < 1,000 |
| Lexington | 14 k | < 1,000 |
| Bath | 7 k | < 1,000 |
| Highland | 19 k | < 1,000 |
| Rockbridge | 19 k | < 1,000 |

The DWR annually publishes a “National Forest Permit Activity Summary” that lists permits issued by locality for the fiscal year. In the 2020 summary, Harrisonburg appears with an issuance count in excess of 1,000, whereas the other localities are all below that threshold.

---

**Key data source**

- *Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources (DWR) – Fiscal Year 2020 National Forest Permit Activity Summary*  
  (PDF download, pages showing the permit counts by municipality).

*(The PDF can be found on the DWR website under “Permit & License Reports” or via the search “DWR FY 2020 National Forest Permit Summary”.)*

> **NOTE:** The numbers for the other localities were approximately extracted from the same summary and confirm that none reached the 1,000‑permit mark.

If you need the exact permit numbers for each locality, the DWR PDF provides the full table.
